name: exchange-webapp

dependencies.name: exchange-api
dependencies.description: Calls the exchange rate API to list supported currencies and fetch the current USD rate for the selected one.

description: React single-page app where any visitor searches/selects a currency and views its current exchange rate to USD along with a last-updated timestamp. No sign-in is required. Holds no exchange-rate data itself and never talks to the external rate provider directly — it always goes through exchange-api.
